title: Vanishing of cohomology above the dimension of a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space, with surjectivity in the top degree and vanishing with support

difficulty_reason: The lemma is the dimension bound for the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module on a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space, together with the surjectivity of the restriction map in the top degree and vanishing with support (statement lines 1769-1781). The proof filters the space into open pieces dominated by quasi-compact separated schemes that are etale and isomorphisms over the successive differences, transfers cohomology with support along these covers, and runs a downwards induction that uses the vanishing theorem for schemes as its input; the top degree statement is proved by the same enlargement procedure. The filtration and the transport of cohomology with support are the substance, so the claim is H2.
